chat.title: AI tutor
chat.clearTopic: Drop this question, ask in general
chat.greetTopic: Hi 👋 I have read this question and its suggested answer. Want me to explain it again, give an example, or grade your draft?
chat.greetGeneral: Hi 👋 Ask me anything about preparing for IT interviews: what to study, how to answer tough questions, salary talks… Open a question from the bank and I will focus on it.
chat.noDraft: You have not written a draft for this question yet. Write one in the Try it tab, then press again.
quickTopic: Explain this again in simpler terms, as if I were a beginner.
Give me another real-world example of this.
What follow-up questions might the interviewer ask after this? Briefly suggest how to answer.
quickGeneral: I am just starting to prepare for interviews. What should I study first?
Give me a few tips for answering technical interview questions.
chat.limit: You have used all {n} messages for this conversation. Start a new one to continue.
